verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for an inference platform with a CLI and SDKs, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents any way to disable telemetry or usage tracking. The usage features shown are billing and consumption monitoring by API key or model, which is a different feature, not an opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
